objective_value: <float> Total cost of shipping, including both per-unit transportation costs and fixed route-opening costs across all used routes.
flow: <list[list[float]], shape [num_sources][num_sinks]> Quantity of goods shipped from each source to each sink.
arcs_used: <list[list[int]], shape [num_sources][num_sinks]> Whether each route from a source to a sink is used for shipping (1 = used, 0 = not used).
